how about simply making fire extinguishers 'attachable tanks' so we can slam them on
plasma and air and such

There are a couple (possibly quick) ways to implement this. I think Capn Lurch's
suggestion of imagining fire extinguishers as basically just a valve which happens to
have high pressure CO2 attached to it is good. That allows us to simplify the code (a
welder is the same, but includes a burner at the end) and expand player options (an
O2 welder, plasma welder, a non-functioning N2O burner, a water spiggot...)

Some small tweaks to code could then also have people attaching igniters to the ends
of fire extinguishers, filling it with plasma and making a flame thrower.

I did code up a quick hack patch that simply made fire extinguishers and welding
tools fillable by both water and welding fuel, but it's a horrible implementation
that isn't modular at all. With recent changes to the gas system I think the idea of
making a tank generically hold a certain set value of chemicals would really be pro.
